headline: Trump administration authorized sales of nearly 900,000 AI chips to China in six months
summary: The Trump administration authorized shipments of nearly 900,000 advanced AI chips made by Nvidia and AMD to Chinese companies between December 2025 and May 2026. The approvals cover a six-month window.
why: Nvidia and AMD design advanced AI accelerators that are central to data center build-outs, and export licensing to China is a major source of revenue risk. US export policy directly shapes these companies' China sales.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Authorized export licences allow Nvidia chips to reach Chinese customers, supporting China revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: AMD
impacts.why: Authorized export licences also cover AMD AI chips sold to Chinese companies.
